title: Maha optimization worker contract v1.0.0
description: The two payloads exchanged between the Maha Vercel backend and an external GPU compute worker (Modal, RunPod, AWS). $defs.WorkerHandoff is sent to the worker; $defs.WorkerCallback is what the worker POSTs to /api/v1/jobs/webhook. Both are generated from lib/jobs/contract.ts, which is the authoritative definition.

j.description: Must satisfy j >= i; the backend rejects lower-triangular duplicates rather than summing them.

value.description: Finite. NaN and Infinity are rejected at the API boundary because they survive JSON.parse and serialize back out as null.

WorkerHandoff.description: Sent by the Maha backend to the worker's job endpoint, with Authorization: Bearer <MAHA_WORKER_TOKEN>.

callbackUrl.description: Absolute URL the worker must POST its result to. Sent per job rather than configured worker-side so preview and production deployments cannot cross-post results.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the backend fails the job and refunds the customer. A callback arriving later is answered 404 and must not be retried.

zeroDataRetention.description: When true the worker must hold problem data in memory only, must not write coefficients to logs or object storage, and must persist nothing after the callback returns 2xx.

size.description: QUBO variable count or Ising spin count.

termsUrl.description: HTTPS pre-signed URL to a sparse term file. Exactly one of terms and termsUrl is non-null.

bondDimensionMax.description: Ceiling on the MPS bond dimension D. Null means the worker chooses.

inputHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical problem encoding. The worker MUST echo this unchanged in its callback; the backend compares and discards mismatched results.

WorkerCallback.description: POSTed by the worker to callbackUrl with header X-Maha-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>, where hex is HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` keyed with MAHA_WORKER_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Signatures older than 300s are rejected.

solution.description: Required when status is completed; null when failed.

objectiveValue.description: Objective of the returned assignment in the SUBMITTED formulation. Do not convert between QUBO and Ising conventions.

assignment.description: Length equals problem.size. QUBO returns 0/1; Ising returns -1/+1.

bestBound.description: Certified bound, or null when the solver certifies none. Do not report the incumbent objective here.

provenOptimal.description: True only when optimality was proven. An absent field is read as false and is never inferred from a zero gap.

bondDimensionUsed.description: Largest D actually reached, which may be below the requested ceiling.

discardedWeight.description: Summed discarded weight across SVD truncations — the honest error measure for the run. Report null if the solver does not track it. Never report 0 to mean 'not measured': a result whose truncation error is unknown is not interpretable, and a false zero states that it is exact.

deviceClass.description: Free-form device label, e.g. "a100-80gb". Recorded for metering; it does not affect the price.

message.description: Must not contain problem coefficients — it is returned to the customer and stored on the job record.

deviceSeconds.description: Metered compute. Recorded for observability only: the credit price is quoted at enqueue and does not move with measured usage.
